accuracy.why: As a guide to 2031 it passes only the adversaries test: every action is litigated or lobbied (the Supreme Court invalidated the IEEPA tariffs on 2026-02-20; rules carry comment periods). The government loses nothing when it rewrites a rule (T1 fails), there is no scoring (T3), and the instruments are short-lived by design - Section 122 duties lapse after 150 days and the chip rules were rewritten in May 2025, January 2026 and November 2026 (T4, T5 fail). What is reliable is the direction and the dated mechanics, not the level.
